_comment: Every Part 2 column this repository reads, with its DuckDB type. dbt's on-run-start hook (dbt/macros/assert_part2_matches_contract.sql) fails the build if any listed table or column is missing from Part 2's analytics.duckdb or has changed type. Columns Part 2 has and this file does not list are ignored. Adding a column here is how a src_ model is allowed to read it; changing a type here is a deliberate commit that means the models reading it need reviewing.

stg_matches._why: Row count only, for the staleness check against the snapshot's manifest.json. No column is read.

int_team_matches._why: One row per team per counting match — Part 2's foundation for every team metric, with the status and split-fixture filters already applied (Part 2 CLAUDE.md §6). Read by src_team_matches.

mart_team_season._why: Previous-season summaries only (CLAUDE.md §5, L2). Read by src_team_season_prior, which re-keys each row by the season it may be used for.

mart_shots._why: One row per shot, deduplicated by Part 2 (its trap 14), with season attached. Read by src_shots for model #3. Understat's xg is read as the benchmark, never as a feature (CLAUDE.md §5, L9).
